summary: Destructor/reset path for an audio emitter object. Attempts to unregister this instance from the SoundManager singleton (dword_8B78A0) via sub_53FB80; on a nonzero return it reports the 'Error deallocating' message through sub_53C590 and returns -1. On success it snapshots the buffer pointer at field 0x4, drains and frees it (EmptyStub_7470 / FreeWrapper_7bcf), zeroes all state fields, resets the mode field 0x30 to the default 6, and returns 0.

operations.description: Attempt to unregister this emitter from the SoundManager singleton: call sub_53FB80(dword_8B78A0, this).
Error-path guard: if sub_53FB80 returns nonzero (unregistration failed), take the error branch.
Report the failure through sub_53C590(-1, aErrorDeallocat), the 'Error deallocating' message literal.
Snapshot the buffer pointer stored at field 0x4 (index 1) into a local before the object is reset.
Reset the mode field 0x30 (index 12) to the default value 6.
If the saved buffer pointer is non-null, drain and free it before clearing the slot.
Drain the saved buffer through EmptyStub_7470.
Release the buffer allocation through FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear field 0x4 (index 1) back to 0 after the buffer has been freed.

unresolved: Exact semantics of sub_53FB80 are unknown; the nonzero-return error interpretation rests on the 'Error deallocating' message.
Roles of fields 0x8..0x34 (indexes 2..13) are unknown; they are treated here as generic state being reset.
What EmptyStub_7470 performs is unknown; it is only known to run on the buffer before FreeWrapper_7bcf frees it.
